local.rationale: Codex runs on the caller-selected GitHub Actions runner. A user-managed runner can execute on the user computer or server; GitHub-hosted runners are GitHub compute, not an OpenAI-managed Codex Action runtime.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Codex runs on the caller-selected GitHub Actions runner. A user-managed runner can execute on the user computer or server; GitHub-hosted runners are GitHub compute, not an OpenAI-managed Codex Action runtime.

laptop-independent.rationale: Runner executes after initiating client disconnects.

unattended-triggers.rationale: PR event starts the configured workflow.

pr-workflow.rationale: The documented review bot returns Codex output to a caller-authored GitHub comment job. The action itself has no pull-request creation or management operation.

cli.rationale: The action ships its own supporting command interface in dist/main.js, named codex-action; scope is workflow setup/run commands.

worktree.rationale: The action configures Codex permission profiles and runner privileges; it does not provide worktree, container or VM isolation options. Caller-provided runner isolation is separate.

container.rationale: The action configures Codex permission profiles and runner privileges; it does not provide worktree, container or VM isolation options. Caller-provided runner isolation is separate.

vm.rationale: The action configures Codex permission profiles and runner privileges; it does not provide worktree, container or VM isolation options. Caller-provided runner isolation is separate.

parallel-runs.rationale: Separate jobs or workflow instances can run the action concurrently, subject to GitHub Actions quotas and caller concurrency settings.

coordinator.rationale: The action starts one Codex process per invocation and supplies no product-owned coordinator or child-agent messaging tools. Codex-native subagents and caller-written workflows are separate.

issue-tracking.rationale: The action exposes prompt inputs and final-message output, with no product-owned issue/task store. GitHub issues and workflow runs belong to GitHub.

multiplayer.rationale: Each action invocation receives a fixed prompt or prompt file and writes a final message; it has no shared live prompting channel.

roles.rationale: The action checks GitHub repository write permission and caller allowlists; it supplies neither native workspace roles nor an enterprise SSO implementation.

sso.rationale: The action checks GitHub repository write permission and caller allowlists; it supplies neither native workspace roles nor an enterprise SSO implementation.

review-ui.rationale: The action returns final-message output or an output file. It has no product interface displaying proposed code diffs.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: The action manages provider credentials and streams Codex output. Its source exposes no action-owned telemetry opt-out control; Codex, GitHub and model-provider collection are separate.

starting-price.rationale: The action source is available without a software purchase; provider and runner costs are separate.

paid-from.rationale: The scoped OWN-04 finding establishes the free Apache-2.0 action with no separate price. Its README requires a user-supplied provider API key; model usage and the GitHub runner are separate from a paid ADE tier. Interpretation checked 2026-11-13 using the recorded findings; source dates retained.

self-hosting.rationale: The action runs on user-controlled runners, including self-managed ones with the unprivileged-user strategy; the model API remains an external dependency.
